title: SpaceEraseData
description:
`space.erase`'s reply: every path it removed. It refuses with `runs_live` while a run
in the space is queued or running, and removes nothing then.

```json
{"removed": ["/Users/u/.aisquare/spaces/default",
             "/Users/u/.claude/projects/-Users-u--aisquare-spaces-default/<run_id>.jsonl"]}
```

removed.description:
The paths removed: the space's folder, its runs' session files, and rlxd's records
of its runs.
